current_phase.next_action: No remaining action; implementation and verification are complete.

audit_findings.finding: Inertia already shares auth.user and the canonical timezone list, but no app-wide selected timezone metadata.
Travel preferences persist home_timezone only through the full settings form.
User dropdown only links to Settings and has no timezone control.
Travel settings use a freeform timezone input instead of a complete dropdown.

decisions_locked_in: Use user_travel_preferences.home_timezone as the durable app-wide timezone preference.
Only auto-save browser detection while the server reports the preference is default-backed.
Place the manual timezone selector in the existing user dropdown.
Reuse TimezoneLookup::identifiers() as the complete timezone option source.
Add a focused endpoint that updates only home_timezone.

ux_rules.manual_selection: Saves immediately and wins over browser detection
ux_rules.auto_detection: Runs once only while the persisted preference is default-backed

verification.summary: ESLint completed with no errors after import ordering fix.

handoff.summary: User timezone preference is implemented and verified. The app shares auth.timezone, the account menu can detect or manually save a timezone, and travel settings use the shared picker.
next_agent_steps: Optionally perform browser QA against the authenticated account menu.
Keep unrelated reservation-itinerary/mobile-ui worktree changes separate when committing.
